[i][b]The Seamore Deal[/b]

The Seamore Deal proposal expanded a cooperation deal between the United States of Oceanica and the United Lavian Republic([nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]). The plan is to maintain some trade protection measures while at the same time moving closer together, further deepening strong cooperation and ties.

The USO imposed a 2.5% tariff on ULR goods to safeguard local industries.
While ULR banks are permitted to operate within the USO to help tourism spending between both parties.

The USO will export more advanced technology, semiconductors, electronic goods, and advanced manufacturing equipment to the ULR. These items will ensure ULR improves its growth rate by becoming more productive and help the USO sustain its position as the technological regional distributor by becoming the dominant source of such goods and brands to meet high quality and advancements.

Oceanican farmers will be able to access ULR markets more easily, and the ULR will be able to get food imports exchanged from the USO while at the same time benefiting from the increased food products.

Brands in textiles and fashion will be able to move more freely, thereby helping the growth of such brands and giving consumers more options in the luxury and medium-range market segment.

The plans to improve tourism by a joint cruise, whereby USO cruise companies can operate in ULR hotspots, and allow open exchange tourism destinations between parties.[/i]
